python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
files = [Path('docs/philosophy.md'), Path('docs/README.md'), *Path('docs/adr').glob('000*.md')]
count = 0
for page in files:
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = page.parent / name if name else page
        assert dest.is_file(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+\s+(.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs, (page, target)
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} local documentation links and anchors.')

from pathlib import Path
import re
files = [Path('docs/philosophy.md'), Path('docs/README.md'), *Path('docs/adr').glob('000*.md')]
count = 0
for page in files:
    content = re.sub(r'`[^`]*`', '', page.read_text())
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', content):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = page.parent / name if name else page
        assert dest.is_file(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+\s+(.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs, (page, target)
        count += 1
print(f'Checked {count} local documentation links and anchors (excluding inline code examples).')
